<function name="Disconnect" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>Disconnects this nav area from given area or ladder. (Only disconnects one way)</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="area" type="CNavArea">The <page>CNavArea</page> or <page>CNavLadder</page> this to disconnect from.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
